tool_args.rationale: The six rows identify the smooth baseline, but the largest drive and largest gradient occur in different rows. The remaining uncertainty is whether an extra sink activates when both are high. The trajectory batch is the remaining probe that can add observations to distinguish those mechanisms before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Submit the smooth saturation model with gradient attenuation and a square-root term
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits all six rows to rounding precision, but a siphon that activates only when both drive and gradient are high could leave those same rows unchanged.
The acquired row had moderate-to-high drive but low gradient (0.30), so its agreement with the smooth model does not test joint activation.
The auxiliary reading would not distinguish the smooth response from a thresholded siphon.
